subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw add `registerControlUiEntryPoint` as a separate public plugin UI API, or fold app-nav/plugin-page launch semantics into the existing `surface: "tab"` descriptor seam with one browser trust model?
rationale: The PR creates a durable plugin SDK, Gateway protocol, and browser security contract; source review can identify unsafe paths, but maintainers must choose the permanent API shape and isolation policy before external plugins depend on it.

options.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
options.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor contract with launch-token behavior and keep plugin pages sandboxed through one public seam.

options.title: Approve Separate API After Hardening
options.body: Keep `registerControlUiEntryPoint` only after removing top-level execution, using an opaque iframe sandbox, failing closed on launch errors, and refreshing exact-head proof.

options.title: Pause For RFC Consolidation
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader native plugin page and Control UI contribution RFCs settle page semantics and browser trust boundaries.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
recommendation.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor contract with launch-token behavior and keep plugin pages sandboxed through one public seam.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged host-hook foundation and broader Control UI contribution RFC are the closest history for the API-shape decision.
